name: Volunteer at the Art Museum of Greater Lafayette
what_you_do: Help at the museum's events during the year. The museum gives volunteers a letter that verifies their hours.
who_can_apply: The page does not state an age rule. Call the museum to ask if teens can volunteer.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Volunteer hours verification papers provided.
deadline_text: No deadline. The museum says it frequently needs volunteers.
how_to_apply: Click Sign Up to Volunteer on the volunteer page (a Google Form). Phone 765-742-1128.
notes: No teen rules are posted, so confirm your age is allowed before you sign up. Museum is at 102 S. 10th Street, Lafayette. Admission is free.
